description.p: Get, remove and update Elder Scrolls Online (ESO) add-ons from ESOUI.com.

ul.li: Scans your AddOns folder for installed add-ons, so it can't forget any it installed
Keeps your own changes to add-ons as patches, re-applied across updates

description.p: Gru is an independent, unofficial tool, not affiliated with ZeniMax Online Studios, Bethesda Softworks or ESOUI.
